english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a young cat and can also be used affectionately as a nickname for a woman.
Use this for a young cat rather than for equipment or clothing.

examples.jyutping: ni1 zek3 maau1 zai2 zan1 hai6 dak1 ji3

examples.english: My friend has a kit, a young cat.
